title: RCA-2025-041: PolicyCenter Full Outage Due to Audit-Logging Deadlock
body: On 2025-11-13 at 15:45 UTC, PolicyCenter became fully unresponsive across all production app server nodes. All request-handling threads entered a BLOCKED state within 7 minutes of a traffic spike coinciding with month-end renewal processing. MIM bridge opened at 15:52. Thread dumps collected at 16:05 showed a classic lock-ordering deadlock: the new AuditLogInterceptor (shipped in PolicyCenter 2025.2.1 to meet SOC2 logging requirements) acquires a write lock on the audit ring-buffer before calling into DocumentGenService, while DocumentGenService's async callback path acquires the same ring-buffer lock before returning control to the interceptor. Under low concurrency this race was never hit in UAT; under renewal-day concurrency (4x normal thread count) it triggered within minutes.
root_cause: Lock-ordering deadlock between AuditLogInterceptor and DocumentGenService, both introduced/modified in PolicyCenter 2025.2.1, only manifesting above a concurrency threshold not exercised in UAT testing.
corrective_actions: Immediate: disabled AuditLogInterceptor via feature flag (gw.audit.interceptor.enabled=false), restored service at 18:20 UTC. Short-term: vendor case GW-88213 opened, Guidewire confirmed defect and committed a fix in 2025.2.2 patch (expected 2025-12-01). Long-term: added a load test scenario at 4x UAT concurrency to the pre-upgrade regression suite for every future release; added deadlock-detection alerting on JVM thread dumps in production APM.

title: RCA-2025-038: Autopay Invoice Gap - 1,200 Accounts Missed in Monthly Run
body: Monthly invoice batch on 2025-11-07 completed with a 0% reported error rate, giving a false sense of success. Finance reconciliation on 2025-11-07 afternoon discovered 1,200 autopay-enrolled accounts had no invoice generated for the cycle. Investigation found InvoiceGenBatch.gs filters accounts using the legacy boolean field cg_autopayenabled_legacy, which was deprecated in BillingCenter 2025.1 in favor of the cg_autopayenrollment entity, but the batch job's filter was never migrated during that upgrade.
root_cause: Batch job filter logic was not updated when the underlying autopay data model changed in BillingCenter 2025.1, and no reconciliation check existed to catch invoice-count anomalies automatically.
corrective_actions: Config change to point InvoiceGenBatch.gs at cg_autopayenrollment (same day fix). Added a post-batch reconciliation check comparing invoice count against active billable accounts, alerting if variance exceeds 1%. Added this class of 'silent batch success with data gap' to the upgrade regression checklist.

title: RCA-2025-045: ClaimCenter Peak-Hour Latency - N+1 Query in Activity Widget
body: Users reported 10-15 second page loads on the claim summary screen specifically between 12pm-2pm, the system's known peak concurrency window. APM distributed traces isolated the slow span to the newly introduced ClaimActivitySummary widget (shipped 3 weeks prior), which fetches related claim activities with one query per activity row instead of a single batched query - a classic N+1 pattern that only becomes visible once concurrent user count and per-claim activity count both cross a threshold.
root_cause: N+1 query pattern in ClaimActivitySummary widget, invisible in low-volume testing, became the dominant latency driver under peak concurrent load.
corrective_actions: Rewrote the widget's data access to use a single batched query keyed by claim_id list. Added a peak-load performance test (simulated 2x historical peak concurrency) to the pre-release checklist for any new ClaimCenter UI widget touching related-entity lookups.
